propositions: Plan-review gate has no criterion to determine whether a proposed change is actually needed, allowing over-action without justification (the FixedBench 35-65% over-action gap).
Bug tickets currently bypass substantive plan review entirely, short-circuiting to bare exempt-PASS with zero LLM calls and no findings.
New advisory-only criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate motivation or reproduction of the issue being addressed, accepting justified no-op or well-motivated outcomes.
Bug tickets must be routed through a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only) instead of being completely exempt, without ever blocking bug claims.

Both necessity criterion and bug review tier must be registered as advisory, non-orphan, and auto-monitored by the standing effectiveness recorder, with promotion to blocking only via operator attestation.
